## LV Contact Ingest — LOCAL (headless-executable)
Same Wave-A JS as the Cloud template, inlined into Code nodes.
**Mocked for local run:** file input -> Emit Fixture Rows; HubSpot search/update/create -> Code mocks (dry-run echo, NO real writes).
**REAL:** the email verifier HTTP node calls the live free API.
AU-phone normalizer is a heuristic; non-AU/ambiguous -> null -> review.
